traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Alangiaceae, which takes in Metteniusaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins pinnate or palmate; stipules absent; plants usually hermaphrodite, rarely dioecious; ovary inferior; stems woody; flowers in cymes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit drupe; stamens 4 to 40; carpels 2 (-3). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
